symptom: `mxcli test --attach` ran no test once a test called a microflow: the incremental build reported CE0108 (message not shown), the fallback cold build passed but asked for a runtime restart, which --attach cannot do; exit 1 and no Total (mendixlabs/mxcli#1874, reproduced on 11.16.1).
cause: The generated test microflow gave every call an ON ERROR handler that read the raised message into a variable ($MxTestErrorMessage_1 = call MxTest.Test_ErrorMessage) and used it. mxbuild --serve's incremental build rejects any USE of a variable created inside an error handler with CE0108 'defined but not in scope'; a full build accepts the same model. Measured on the dev serve with variants: the handler as generated fails, the same handler returning the variable fails, defining it without using it builds, and no variable builds.
file: cmd/mxcli/testrunner/generator_endpoint.go (rewriteBodyForVerdict, rewriteBodyForThrows, GenerateTestFlows), cmd/mxcli/testrunner/client.go (toResult), cmd/mxcli/docker/serve_recovery.go (recheckIncrementalErrors prints the errors)
fix: The endpoint path generates no handler: the error leaves the test microflow, the endpoint (which already caught it) returns its message, and toResult makes it FAIL 'exception during execution: <msg>' or, for @throws, PASS/FAIL against the annotation (MDL-literal apostrophes undone). The serve recovery now prints the incremental build's CE0108 lines, document and message.
insight: Printing the suppressed error was the cheapest step and the decisive one: 'Variable MxTestErrorMessage_1 ... not in scope' named mxcli's own generated variable, which turned an 'mxbuild state' story into a reproducible shape that four handler variants against the live dev serve (curl POST /build) narrowed in minutes. Separately observed and NOT fixed here: after an --attach run whose builds fell back to a separate serve process, the dev serve's next build reports restartRequired=true for an unchanged model (then false), so a second --attach run can be refused with 'an entity or association changed'.
test: testrunner: generator_endpoint_test TestGenerateTestFlowsLeavesCallsToTheEndpoint (fails against the old generator), client_test TestToResult_ThrownTestMicroflow, throws_test; live on 11.16.1: the repro's call test PASSes under --attach, and four tests give verdicts identical to the old handler's (--local, main build)
